nameForms.name: Duke of Bavaria
nameForms.note: Hereditary duchy held by the Wittelsbach line from 1180.
nameForms.noteCn: 1180 年起由维特尔斯巴赫世系持有的世袭公国。

holders.note: Received Bavaria after Henry the Lion's deprivation.
holders.noteCn: 狮子亨利被剥夺巴伐利亚后获授。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Otto II; after the 1255 partition the Upper Bavaria line.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父奥托二世；1255 年分割后沿上巴伐利亚支。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Louis II; Holy Roman Emperor from 1328.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父路易二世；1328 年起兼神圣罗马帝国皇帝。

holders.note: Succeeded after the 1347 divisions; reconsolidated Bavaria.
holders.noteCn: 1347 年分割后继承；巴伐利亚再整合阶段。

holders.note: John II ruled Bavaria jointly with his brothers after Stephen II's death.
holders.noteCn: 斯蒂芬二世去世后，约翰二世与兄弟共同统治巴伐利亚。

holders.note: The 1392 partition made John II the first duke of the Munich branch, the paternal line of Maximilian I.
holders.noteCn: 1392 年分割后，约翰二世成为慕尼黑支首任公爵；该支正是马克西米连一世的父系。
